interface.title: Climate Change in Graphs
interface.field: Climate science (paleoclimate, observed climate, emissions, cryosphere, oceans, energy systems)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and contextualizing published reference datasets (reading results, not analysis or data entry)
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit dashboard where a user picks a topic page, then chooses a year range, a graph variant, countries, a hemisphere or a season to view interactive Plotly charts of curated climate datasets: temperature reconstructions, greenhouse-gas concentrations and emissions, ice, sea level, energy, and IPCC forcing/sensitivity assessments.

data.note: All data comes from the bundled data/ files. Live fetches (NOAA, GISS, HadCRUT, Berkeley Earth, etc.) time out in the sandbox, so pages take a few seconds to load and show 'Running get_...()' spinners first. Nothing is uploaded. Sources are cited on each page (OWID, EDGAR, Climate Action Tracker, NSIDC, EPA, CSIRO, Copernicus, NASA, IPCC AR6).

tree.general: Put current climate change in context by comparing observed, reconstructed and projected indicators across datasets, regions and time spans
tree.specific: Browse the Climate Change in Graphs topic dashboards and adjust year ranges, graph variants, countries, hemispheres and seasons to compare temperature, GHG, emissions, ice, ocean and forcing records

features.name: Range slider with numeric bound boxes driving linked charts
features.general: Set a start and end value by dragging two handles or typing exact numbers; every chart tied to the control is re-cropped to that window
features.specific: 'What timescale are you interested in?' slider with lower/upper spinboxes (negative = BCE). One slider controls both Graph 2 (GHG concentrations) and Graph 3 (Antarctic temperature vs CO2); the Emissions and Energy pages use plain two-handle year sliders
steps: Drag the left or right handle, or type a year into the lower/upper box and press Enter
Charts below redraw for the chosen window
Use the +/− buttons to step a bound by one year
Scroll on to any other chart driven by the same slider
serves_tasks: Narrow the comparison to a time window
Zoom to the last millennium to see where proxy and instrumental records meet
Compare national emission trajectories

features.name: Entity multiselect for multi-line comparison
features.general: Pick several items (countries, regions) from a searchable list of tags; each becomes a line on a shared chart
features.specific: 'Select Countries' tag multiselect with type-ahead (e.g. 'Ind' lists India, Indonesia...), feeding GHG-by-country, per-capita GHG and per-capita energy line charts; the default set changes when the graph variant changes
steps: Click into the multiselect
Type part of a name
Pick from the filtered list
Remove a tag with its × or Clear all
Read the updated multi-line chart
serves_tasks: Compare national emission trajectories
Normalize national emissions by population
Compare per-capita energy use across countries for a chosen source

features.name: Graph-variant selector
features.general: Swap one chart slot between related views of the same topic (another dataset, a normalization, a faceted breakdown) without leaving the page
features.specific: 'Select graph' / 'Choose a graph' / 'Select assessment' dropdowns: one temperature record with uncertainty vs four-dataset anomaly; world by gas vs by country vs per capita; world vs regional sector facets; ECS vs TCR
steps: Open the dropdown
Choose a variant
The chart, its title and its controls (e.g. the country picker) change to match
serves_tasks: Overlay several independent reconstructions on one chart
Break emissions down by economic sector, globally and by region
Compare climate-sensitivity estimates from different lines of evidence

features.name: Interactive chart legend and viewport (show/hide series, hover, box zoom, reset)
features.general: Inspect overlapping series on a chart: hide or isolate series from the legend, read exact values on hover, drag a box to zoom, and reset the view
features.specific: Plotly modebar and legend on every chart: click a legend entry to hide it, double-click to isolate, hover tooltips (dataset, value, year), Zoom/Pan, Zoom in/out, Autoscale, Reset axes, Download PNG
steps: Click a legend entry to hide that series (double-click isolates it)
Hover a line or box to read its values
Drag a rectangle to zoom in
Press Reset axes to return to the full view
serves_tasks: Inspect differences between records closely
Look at radiative forcing over time and isolate the total
Compare feedback estimates across model generations

features.name: Region / variable / season filter with trendline
features.general: Filter a seasonal time series by region, variable and season, and see it with a fitted linear trend (and a moving average for the monthly view)
features.specific: Ice Graph 1: 'Choose a hemisphere' (N/S) × 'Choose a variable' (Extent/Area) × 'Choose a season' (All/Winter/Autumn/Summer/Spring); the all-seasons view adds a 12-month moving average. Seasons are calendar-month groups for both hemispheres (get_data.py:107–115), so Southern 'Summer' is austral winter. Ice Graph 4 has a similar season selector for snow cover
steps: Choose a hemisphere
Choose a variable
Choose a season
Read the series with its trendline, then repeat for the other hemisphere
serves_tasks: Isolate one season's trend
Repeat for the other hemisphere and another variable
Check seasonal snow-cover trends

features.name: Country choropleth with metric selector
features.general: Show a value per country on a world map, switch which metric is mapped, zoom or pan, and hover a country to read its value
features.specific: Emissions Graph 2: cumulative 1850–2023, total 2023, or per capita 2023 GHG emissions on a colour scale; hovering shows country, ISO code and value. Energy Graph 5 does the same for per-capita consumption by source
steps: Choose the metric in the dropdown
Zoom in with the modebar (the mouse wheel over the map also zooms)
Hover a country to read its value
Press Reset to restore the view
serves_tasks: Map emissions by country

features.name: Time series with uncertainty band and smoothing
features.general: Plot a measured or reconstructed quantity through time as a central estimate with a running mean or trendline and a shaded uncertainty or confidence band, so the trend can be read against its error
features.specific: Temperature Graph 1 (annual mean, 5-year moving average, 5-year uncertainty band); Temperature Graph 6 PhanDA GMST and CO2 medians with 84%/95% bands; Ocean Graph 1 CSIRO sea-level reconstruction with uncertainty; Ocean Graph 2 Copernicus altimetry with 90% CI and trendline
steps: Read the central annual or median line
Compare it with the moving average or trendline
Read the band width to see where the record is less certain
Hover to read values for a given year
serves_tasks: View one record with its uncertainty band
Compare temperature and CO2 over deglacial and geological time
Follow sea-level rise from reconstruction through satellites to projections

features.name: Scenario fan chart with end-of-period labels
features.general: Show the historical record continued by several future scenarios, each as a line or ensemble range, labelled with its end-of-period outcome so pathways can be compared at a glance
features.specific: Temperature Graph 7 CMIP6 10th/50th/90th quantiles for SSP1-2.6/2-4.5/5-8.5 plus historical and instrumental; Emissions Graph 4 CAT pathways to 2100 labelled with end-of-century warming and Graph 5 warming per pathway; Ocean Graph 3 SSP sea-level projections to 2150 with 17–83% bands
steps: Find where the observed or historical record ends
Follow each scenario's central line forward
Compare the spread of each scenario's band
Read the end-of-period label or value for each scenario
serves_tasks: Place the observed record against model projections to 2100
Compare emissions with mitigation pathways and the warming they imply
Follow sea-level rise from reconstruction through satellites to projections

features.name: Dual-axis overlay of quantities through time
features.general: Draw two or more quantities with different units on twin y-axes over a shared time axis, so their co-variation can be compared directly
features.specific: Temperature Graph 2 (CO2, CH4 and N2O on dual axes), Graph 3 (Antarctic temperature change vs CO2) and Graph 5 (NH continental temperature and CO2 over 20 Myr); Graphs 2–3 follow the shared timescale slider
steps: Match each line to its axis by colour
Set the time window with the linked slider
Compare where the curves rise and fall together
Hover to read each quantity's value
serves_tasks: View the full 800,000-year concentration record
Zoom to the last millennium to see where proxy and instrumental records meet
Compare temperature and CO2 over deglacial and geological time

features.name: Ranges and best estimates across lines of evidence
features.general: Compare an assessed quantity's best estimate and likely range across independent lines of evidence or model generations, as range bars or box plots
features.specific: Quantities Graph 6 ECS/TCR estimates by line of evidence (switched with 'Select assessment'); Graph 5 box plots of Net/Planck/WV+LR/Albedo/Cloud feedbacks for CMIP5, CMIP6 and AR6 with quartiles on hover
steps: Choose the quantity to compare
Read each source's central value and range
Hover a box or bar for median and quartiles
Compare spreads between sources
serves_tasks: Compare feedback estimates across model generations
Compare climate-sensitivity estimates from different lines of evidence
